Name: Music Replacement Framework (No longer maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

A mod that swaps vanilla music and replaces them with other music.

[b]How it works:[/b]
1. You download this mod as the Audio player.
2. Download music packs to play those packs.

This mod plays Vanilla track if no modded audio is found otherwise it will shuffle all of the music pack for the playing track and instead plays the modded track. You can turn on and off individual modded music tracks as well. There is also an option to allow Vanilla music in the shuffle with the modded audio if it's turned on in settings.

[b]Demo sample from DM music pack:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41866]Download this DM music pack here[/url]
[/b][youtube]fqcocw4x3lk[/youtube]
[b]Platform[/b]
Works on PC and Android

[b]Supported Audio[/b]
OGG/Wav

[b]How to create your own music pack[/b]
Mod comes with a sample manifest and sample musicreplacement.json if you copy these into a folder for your mod and add music that's all you need to do to create your own music pack.  The game has config option to turn on so when a game music play you can copy the console line into the file and just add your music and done.
Will add more instructions and or video later if folks are interested.

Steps
[spoiler]
[b]1.Start from a working template (easiest method)[/b]
Download DM voice pack (remove the assets) then just modify the manifest.json and musicReplacement.json as your own mod folder. Make sure to change the author and mod name to yours, unique id, and nexusmod so it points to your mod page when you create it.

[b]2. Find the exact music keys to add to musicReplacement.json using SMAPI logging[/b]
Load up the game
In GMCM -> turn on logging and save.
Go to the event/location you replace music for. When music plays the SMAPI log will give you the exact line to copy and paste into  musicReplacement.json .

Example in Abigail's 10 heart event
when the scene starts it'll print to SMAPI console like this
[quote]"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine|EventId=901756|TrackPlay=1": [ "" ],
 "Upper_Ambient|EventId=901756|TrackPlay=1": [ "" ],
"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine|EventId=901756": [ "" ],
 "Upper_Ambient|EventId=901756": [ "" ],
"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine|EventUp": [ "" ],
"Upper_Ambient|EventUp": [ "" ],
"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine": [ "" ],
"Upper_Ambient": [ "" ],[/quote]
[b]3. Choose how specific you want the music replacement to be[/b]
Each line controls how broadly or narrowly the replacement applies. Since in this example I want to replace Upper_Ambient only in this event at this location and only when this song is played for the first time in this event, I'll chose to copy the first line into my musicReplacement.json  and between the quotes add my song file location.

[quote]﻿"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine|EventId=901756|TrackPlay=1": [ "MyMusicFile.ogg" ],[/quote]
[b]4. Repeat [/b]
Now you repeat for rest of the scene and keep copying every music you want to replace into your file with its replacement song.

[b]5.  Prevent music from restarting between tracks[/b]
Map multiple event tracks to the same audio file. Example in Abigail's 10 heart event's last 2 music track are the [b]sad piano[/b] song, and [b]Upper Ambient[/b] so set both track and point them to same song to resolve.

[quote]"sadpiano|Location=Mine|EventId=901756|TrackPlay=1": [ "YourOwnSong.ogg" ],
"Upper_Ambient|Location=Mine|EventId=901756|TrackPlay=2": [ "YourOwnSong.ogg" ],[/quote]

[b] Note[/b]: All songs are stopped at the end of events to prevent longer tracks from playing into normal gameplay. 
[/spoiler]

Sample of the file below for priority picking order
[spoiler]
[quote]﻿{
  // ============================================================
  // DMMusic – Priority
  //
  // When multiple entries could match the same music request,
  // the MOST SPECIFIC key always wins.
  //
  // TrackPlay is OPTIONAL.
  // If omitted, the entry applies to ALL occurrences of that track.
  //
  // Priority order:
  //
  // 1) Track + Location + EventId + TrackPlay
  //    "Track|Location=Town|EventId=123456|TrackPlay=2"
  //
  // 2) Track + EventId + TrackPlay
  //    "Track|EventId=123456|TrackPlay=2"
  //
  // 3) Track + Location + EventId
  //    "Track|Location=Town|EventId=123456"
  //
  // 4) Track + EventId
  //    "Track|EventId=123456"
  //
  // 5) Track + Location + EventUp
  //    "Track|Location=Town|EventUp"
  //
  // 6) Track + EventUp
  //    "Track|EventUp"
  //
  // 7) Track + Location
  //    "Track|Location=Town"
  //
  // 8) Track only (default / fallback)
  //    "Track"
  //
  // More specific keys override less specific ones.
  //
  // NOTE:
  // - TrackPlay=N counts how many times THIS TRACK is requested
  //   during the SAME EVENT.
  // - TrackPlay=1 = first time the track plays in the event
  // - TrackPlay=2 = second time, etc.
  // ============================================================
  // ============================================================
  // 1) Track + Location + EventId + TrackPlay (MOST SPECIFIC)
  // Use this to replace ONLY a specific occurrence in an event.
  // ============================================================
  // Example: The SECOND time spring1 plays in this event
  "spring1|Location=Town|EventId=123456|TrackPlay=2": "assets/FinalMoment.ogg",
  // Example: THIRD time the same track plays (rare but possible)
  "spring1|Location=Town|EventId=123456|TrackPlay=3": "assets/Epilogue.ogg",
  // ============================================================
  // 2) Track + EventId + TrackPlay
  // Applies anywhere in the event, regardless of location
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|EventId=123456|TrackPlay=1": "assets/EventIntro.ogg",
  // ============================================================
  // 3) Track + Location + EventId
  // Applies to ALL plays of this track in this event
  // (unless TrackPlay overrides it)
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|Location=Town|EventId=123456": [
    "assets/ExactEventTown_A.ogg",
    "assets/ExactEventTown_B.ogg"
  ],
  // ============================================================
  // 4) Track + EventId
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|EventId=123456": "assets/SpecificEventTheme.ogg",
  // ============================================================
  // 5) Track + Location + EventUp
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|Location=Town|EventUp": [
    "assets/TownEvent_A.ogg",
    "assets/TownEvent_B.ogg"
  ],
  // ============================================================
  // 6) Track + EventUp
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|EventUp": "assets/SpringEventTheme.ogg",
  // ============================================================
  // 7) Track + Location
  // ============================================================
  "spring1|Location=Town": "assets/TownSpring.ogg",
  "spring1|Location=Forest": [
    "assets/ForestSpring_A.ogg",
    "assets/ForestSpring_B.ogg"
  ],
  // ============================================================
  // 8) Track only (default / fallback)
  // ============================================================
  // Track only (single)
  "spring1": "assets/SpringOnTheMeadow.ogg",
  // Track only (shuffle list)
  "spring2": [
    "assets/Spring2_A.ogg",
    "assets/Spring2_B.ogg"
  ],
  // ============================================================
  // Special case: Temp cutscene bucket
  // (Intro / cutscene-style music often reports Location=Temp
  //  while EventUp=false)
  // ============================================================
  "grandpas_theme|Location=Temp": [
    "assets/WhisperingGoodbye.ogg",
    "assets/AltWhisper.ogg"
  ],
  "jojaOfficeSoundscape|Location=Temp": "assets/EndlessShiftAtJoja.ogg"
}[/quote][/spoiler]
